tasks.label: backend: dev
tasks.command: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not (Test-Path .venv)) { try { py -3.11 -m venv .venv } catch { python -m venv .venv } }; . .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; if (Test-Path requirements-local.txt) { pip install -r requirements-local.txt } else { pip install -r requirements.txt }; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///./dev.db'; uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 }"

tasks.label: frontend: dev
tasks.command: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (Test-Path package-lock.json) { npm ci } else { npm install }; $env:VITE_API_BASE='http://localhost:8000'; npm run dev }"
